verdict.rationale: smolagents is itself an official Python library: it installs via pip, has a documented class API (CodeAgent, ToolCallingAgent, Tool subclassing) and a reference page, so developers can build against it programmatically. The evidence shows only a single Python package, with nothing on SDKs in other languages, versioning or stability guarantees, or a client SDK for any hosted service, so coverage of the story is incomplete. missing for 10: official SDKs in languages beyond Python, documented SDK versioning/stability guarantees, independent hands-on corroboration of the SDK developer experience.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can build against official SDKs

citations.quote: `smolagents` is a library that enables you to run powerful agents in a few lines of code.
pip install 'smolagents[toolkit]'  # Includes default tools like web search
The custom tool subclasses Tool to inherit useful methods... A `forward` method which contains the inference code to be executed.
